verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas scripting system lets developers attach code to entities that respond to events (input, collisions, physics) and drive game logic, and the Editor API/MCP server let external agents programmatically react to and manipulate project state — but there is no first-class 'rules engine' or declarative trigger/action automation framework documented, only general-purpose scripting and API access. Missing for 10: a documented rules/trigger-action system, event-subscription API examples, and independent confirmation of automated event-driven workflows.
